description: This file defines the ExceptionHandler class for MySQL database exceptions within Drupal, handling and rethrowing specific database-related exceptions based on SQL error codes and states.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles MySQL database exceptions, rethrowing them as specific Drupal database exception classes based on error codes and states.
